label: Langrisser V: The End of Legend (Sega Saturn, JP)
_max_font_slot_comment: Slot 1820's 18 bytes cross file offset 0x8000, where SYSTEM.DAT keeps the group pointer directory.

verify.note: T-2509G v1.004 data track. Every file the patch touches lives on this track; the whole-image hash is not comparable across rips because a mixed-mode dump may or may not store the audio pregaps.

_system_groups_comment: File offset of each SYSTEM text group's offset table, in scan order. Pack keys name a group by its position in this list, so the list is what turns a pack key into an address on this build.
_unnamed_glyph_slots_comment: Where this build keeps a glyph the font map leaves unnamed, keyed by the slot the pack writes (PS1's). Named glyphs need no entry - the maps already say which slot holds each character here - and slots below the game's kanji_bank_start hold the same glyph on every release. Only text that names a glyph by raw <$XXXX> token reaches this list. Derived and checked by `saturn_reconcile glyphs`, which is the step allowed to open both discs; the build only reads it.
_system_loose_comment: Text runs outside the group tables, in scan order. This build has none: every SYSTEM string it shows belongs to a group.
